decontamination_notes: Real CRLF header-injection fix from nodejs/undici PR #5579 (https://github.com/nodejs/undici/pull/5579), merged 2026-07-22 -- after the training cutoffs of the models evaluated here (e.g. Opus 5, May 2026), so the specific fix is not in their training data (decontaminated: true), with upstream_merged recorded as proof. In lib/core/request.js::processHeader, string header values are validated with isValidHeaderValue, but non-string values (and non-string array elements) are coerced via `${val}` and pushed WITHOUT validation, so a function with a crafted toString / Symbol.toPrimitive can smuggle CRLF into a header value (request/response splitting). The fix runs the coerced string through isValidHeaderValue (already imported and used for string values) and throws InvalidArgumentError on failure, at both the array-element else-branch and the scalar else-branch. undici is a zero-runtime-dependency package; hidden tests are plain CommonJS run with `node --test` on the base image (Node 22). They assert client.request() rejects specifically with InvalidArgumentError for a CRLF payload -- at the base commit the value is accepted and the request instead rejects with a network error (AggregateError/ECONNREFUSED to a closed localhost port, fast under the network-off sandbox loopback), so each fail_to_pass genuinely fails pre-patch. Repo sliced at the PR base commit (lib/ + index.js, 37.8k LOC); MIT LICENSE preserved (root + lib/web/fetch). Coverage floor: 3 fail_to_pass (toString, Symbol.toPrimitive, array-element coercions) plus a no-regression guard that a valid header value is NOT rejected as invalid.

fail_to_pass.name: crlf_tostring
fail_to_pass.cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern='^vb rejects coerced CRLF header via toString$' vb_crlf_injection.test.js

fail_to_pass.name: crlf_toprimitive
fail_to_pass.cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern='^vb rejects coerced CRLF header via Symbol.toPrimitive$' vb_crlf_injection.test.js

fail_to_pass.name: crlf_array_element
fail_to_pass.cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern='^vb rejects coerced CRLF header in an array element$' vb_crlf_injection.test.js

pass_to_pass.name: valid_header_ok
pass_to_pass.cmd: node --test --test-name-pattern='^vb valid header value is not rejected as invalid$' vb_valid_header_regression.test.js
